brand.title: Bringing the warmth of Japanese craft closer to you
brand.lead: orangekoko began with a simple wish: to help people in Europe who love Japanese handmade aesthetics discover small works worth treasuring.
brand.beginning1: Japan is home to many wonderful handmade creations. Their appeal lies in thoughtfully chosen materials, expressive designs and the care given to the smallest details. Yet many of these works circulate mainly within Japan, making them difficult to discover and buy from abroad.
brand.beginning2: I want orangekoko to be a small bridge between these makers and people in Europe who appreciate their work. I select handmade jewelry by independent Japanese artisans, hoping to make a carefully chosen, beautifully crafted gift feel a little closer, wherever you are.
brand.aestheticsTitle: Beauty found in the seasons and everyday life
brand.aesthetics1: A flower opening in spring, light resting on a leaf after rain, the changing colours of a season: Japanese handmade design often finds inspiration close to home. Plants and ordinary objects become starting points for something unexpected and personal.
brand.aesthetics2: There is sweetness in this aesthetic, but also movement and imagination. Delicate earrings or a thoughtful necklace can bring a look to life without demanding attention. A playful shape, a quiet colour or a tiny botanical detail can make an ordinary day feel more your own.
brand.craftTitle: Care is part of the craft
brand.craft1: I especially value the seriousness with which many Japanese makers approach their work. The idea of shokunin speaks to respect for a craft and the patient commitment to doing it well. It is an attitude expressed through practice and attention, rather than a label every maker needs to claim.
brand.craft2: That care can be found in the choice of materials, the balance of colour and proportion, the finishing of an edge or connection, and consideration for how a piece feels when worn. Some details are easy to miss at first; their value becomes clearer when you look closely and live with the work.
brand.craft3: When choosing jewelry for orangekoko, I look at the design, materials, finish and the thought behind these details. My wish is to offer pieces whose beauty and quality invite a closer look, and which you can give with confidence and affection.
brand.givingTitle: For someone dear, or for yourself
brand.giving1: A birthday, an anniversary, a reunion or a thank-you that is hard to put into words: meaningful moments deserve a gift chosen with care. I hope these pieces help you say, “I thought of you,” in a way that feels personal.
brand.giving2: A gift can also be for you: to mark a brave decision, celebrate a beginning or find a little tenderness in a busy week. Something carefully selected and beautifully made can become a sweet comfort in daily life, bringing you back to a person, a moment or a feeling you want to keep.
brand.cards1: The jewelry here is made by Japanese artisans; the greeting cards are made by me. I want a gift to hold both something worth keeping and words worth remembering. Jewelry can accompany everyday life, while a card explains why this person, this moment and this choice matter to you.
brand.cards2: A card can also be a gift in its own right. A note of thanks, a quiet encouragement or a message to your future self deserves paper and details made with care. Together or separately, jewelry and cards make room for a more personal kind of giving.
brand.closing: This is the heart of orangekoko: bringing the beauty and care of Japanese craft across a distance, so you can find an exceptional, thoughtfully chosen gift for someone dear, or a little comfort for yourself.

about.title: A small shop, and a very personal wish
about.lead: I want the things I choose and make for orangekoko to help someone feel remembered. That is the thread connecting every piece of jewelry and every greeting card in this shop.
about.discoveryTitle: The beauty I want to share
about.discovery1: What draws me to Japanese handmade work is often a small detail: a shape that recalls a petal, a gentle colour, or an unexpected touch of playfulness. These objects carry a way of noticing the world, with room for seasons, plants and everyday discoveries.
about.discovery2: Many wonderful creations remain close to their makers, sold mainly within Japan. I wanted to open a way for people in Europe to encounter this work too, and to find gifts that feel considered, distinctive and full of character.
about.selectionTitle: What I look for when choosing a piece
about.selection1: The jewelry collection is made by independent artisans in Japan. I choose with attention to materials, design and finish, looking for pieces that are charming without overwhelming the person wearing them. I want a little detail to bring joy to an outfit and remain lovely on a closer look.
about.selection2: I also value the attitude behind the work: the seriousness of doing something well, the patience to refine a detail, and respect for the person who will eventually wear it. This is what the spirit of shokunin means to me. It shapes how I think about selecting pieces worthy of a meaningful gift.
about.cardsTitle: The part I make with my own hands
about.cards1: The greeting cards are my own handmade work. Alongside choosing jewelry, I wanted to create a place for the words that belong with a gift. Paper, texture and small visual details can make a handwritten message feel even more personal.
about.cards2: You might choose a card to accompany a necklace, or simply send one to say that someone has been on your mind. A card leaves room for your own voice, whether the occasion is a celebration, a thank-you or a little encouragement on an ordinary day.
about.promiseTitle: A gift with someone in mind
about.promise1: I imagine a person opening a present and recognising the thought behind it. That thought might come from a detail that suits them, a remembered conversation or a few handwritten lines. A gift becomes special through the care of the person choosing it.
about.promise2: And sometimes that person is you. You do not need a grand occasion to mark a new chapter or give yourself a little comfort. I hope orangekoko helps you find something beautifully made that feels right for the moment, and carries its warmth into everyday life.
about.closing: Japanese jewelry, chosen with care. Cards made by me. Given a meaning of their own by you.
